'''R1-G4''' was an [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1-series]] astromech droid produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
R1-G4 was an old-model astromech droid, whose owner was captured by an unknown group on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], possibly the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|sand people]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was abandoned on planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but later recovered by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] in Chief [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit's]] tribe, who stowed R1-G4 aboard their [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]], after incapacitating it. There it was rebuilt, to be sold to Tatooine colonists. R1-G4 was part of the line-up assembled at the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] as a prospective purchase for [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]. Lars eventually chose [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and the [[Desert Sands]] [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtrooper]] unit destroyed the sandcrawler while searching for those very droids.

R1's [[cold box]] contained stolen transponder data.<ref name="VG8">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp08.html|text=Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 8: Droids for Sale}}</ref>
